email_body: Hi John, I need you to approve the attached wire transfer request for the new vendor. This is time-sensitive and must be completed before EOD. Let me know if you have questions.
indicators: Sender email address mimics CEO but uses a lookalike domain; Urgency to bypass normal verification processes; Attachment requesting sensitive financial action; Targeted specifically at CFO role responsible for wire transfers

email_subject: Request for Employee Salary Data for Audit
email_body: Dear Sarah, the external auditors require an updated salary report for all employees by tomorrow. Please find the template attached and send the completed document once done.
indicators: Email impersonates trusted audit firm known to HR; Request for sensitive employee salary data; Attachment contains malicious macros to steal credentials; Targeted at HR Manager who handles employee records
